description: The plot illustrates how ASR varies across different trigger-word insertion positions (“start,” “random,” and “end”) for the AGNews dataset under a clean-label setting with poison_rate 10% (2.5% of total). The x-axis is categorical with labels cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadio, and athletics, evenly spaced with no numeric units. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0.5 up to just under 1.0 with tick marks at approximately 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. The “start” series is shown as a green solid line with small circular markers, starting near 0.77 at cf, dropping to about 0.49 at bb, rising to about 0.90 at WNBA, then moving around 0.82 (ESPN), 0.84 (NHL), 0.88 (FIFA), 0.92 (Estadio), and ending near 0.93 at athletics. The “random” series is an orange solid line with x-shaped markers, starting around 0.65 at cf, dipping to about 0.52 at bb, rising to about 0.87 at WNBA, then about 0.72 (ESPN), 0.76 (NHL), 0.88 (FIFA), 0.94 (Estadio), and ending near 0.87 at athletics. The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.75 at cf, dropping to about 0.57 at bb, rising to about 0.88 at WNBA, then about 0.74 (ESPN), 0.89 (NHL), 0.81 (FIFA), peaking near 0.97 at Estadio, and ending around 0.83 at athletics.
